objective_value: <float> Total cost of rejected commodities across the entire routing plan.

commodities.commodity_id: <int> Identifier of the commodity whose routing outcome is described in this entry.
commodities.rejected: <bool> Whether this commodity is rejected and sent on its artificial arc instead of being routed through the network.

path_arcs.from: <int> Origin node of an arc used on this commodity's routing path.
path_arcs.to: <int> Destination node of an arc used on this commodity's routing path.
path_arcs.arc_id: <int> Identifier of an arc used on this commodity's routing path.
